title: 1.3-mm ALMA observations of the Fomalhaut debris system
question: What is the 1.3 mm morphology of Fomalhaut's debris ring, its mm spectral index and grain size slope, and is there central emission in excess of the stellar photosphere indicating an inner debris component?

what.value: Literature disc and stellar flux densities 70 um-6.6 mm and 0.554-24 um used in SED and spectral index fits (Table flux_list)

evidence.quote: with literature values for flux densities at different wavelengths (see Table [\[flux_list\]](#flux_list)).

external_data.citation: Ricci 2012, Boley 2012, Su 2016, Holland 2003/1998, Acke 2012, Ishihara 2010, Pickles 2010, Boyajian 2013

evidence.quote: The photosphere temperature of the star is constrained to be T$_{B} = 8600 \pm200$ K from *Herschel* observations (cite: acke).

recipe.method: CASA CLEAN of 233 GHz continuum, natural weighting, threshold 0.5 sigma

recipe.goal: Image-plane MCMC ring + point source fit
recipe.method: Model attenuated by primary beam, convolved with synthetic beam, compared to dirty image with chi^2; Metropolis-Hastings
key_parameters: 3 chains, 100000 links, thinned by 10, sigma = 374 uJy
assumptions: Gaussian radial profile, vertical Gaussian width 1 deg, point source at phase centre

recipe.method: Predict model visibilities with setvp/predict and chi^2 on real and imaginary parts with weights
e from de-projected offsets over semi-major axis; mass from grain size distribution q=3.5
assumptions: density 2.5 g/cc for 1.3 mm grains; 1 g/cc, Dmax 50 km for cascade

recipe.goal: Spectral index and grain size slope
recipe.method: Bayesian MCMC fit of F_nu ∝ nu^alpha to ring fluxes; q=(alpha_mm-alpha_pl)/beta_s+3
Bayesian black body fits to subsets of stellar flux data; 10% uncertainty when missing
assumptions: Su et al. 870 um flux used rather than Boley

evidence.quote: with a most probable flux of $0.90\pm 0.12$ mJy (including calibration uncertainties)
we find a total mass of M$(\rm D<50\,km) \sim 6~ M_{\bigoplus}$

not_stated_but_needed: Image size and cell size for CLEAN
Whether pipeline or manual calibration and CASA version
Flux scale uncertainty treatment (calibration uncertainty inflating 0.12 vs 0.15 mJy)
MCMC proposal widths and initial parameter values, prior ranges
Mapping of image-plane sigma and treatment of primary beam in the fits
Code for the ring model is not provided
score_reason: Public data and clear model description, but custom code and imaging details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results, model equations given, though code not released.
